items.title: GPT-2: 6-month follow-up
items.summary: We’re releasing the 774 million parameter GPT-2 language model after the release of our small 124M model in February, staged release of our medium 355M model in May, and subsequent research with partners and the AI community into the model’s potential for misuse and societal benefit. We’re also releasing an open-source legal agreement to make it easier for organizations to initiate model-sharing partnerships with eac
items.summaryZh: OpenAI正式发布了7.74亿参数规模的GPT-2语言模型，此前已依次发布1.24亿和3.55亿参数版本。本次发布伴随着开源法律协议和技术报告，旨在与AI研究界共同探索模型潜在风险与社会效益，规范模型共享机制。

aiReview.reasonZh: 标志着GPT-2中等规模（7.74亿参数）模型的正式开源发布，是AI发展史上的重要里程碑。
